watches.name: Little to be Big
watches.description: A portion of proceeds supports Big Brothers Big Sisters of America. Introducing the first Big Brothers Big Sisters watch – Designed with their mission at its heart, its timeless stainless steel case and black dial are accented by their signature colors and a luminous slogan, reflecting the spark they aim to create in every child. Wear this and carry a story of hope, mentorship, and positive change on your wrist. It's not just about telling time; it's about making every second count for a brighter future. PRE-ORDER NOW - Shipping in 2027 $40 of the proceeds gets donated to BBBS

watches.name: The River Watch
watches.description: This titanium timepiece is built with a mission: it's waterproof, river-ready , and features a dual-time GMT function for global travel. Experience the spirit of the mighty Hudson River on your wrist with this exclusive, limited-edition timepiece—a powerful partnership between Riverkeeper and Core Timepieces . Crafted for the conscious adventurer, every detail of this watch is inspired by the river, and every purchase fuels its protection. All proceeds fund the restoration of the Hudson River.

watches.name: Seven Sins Red Dial Titanium Automatic
watches.description: A bold fusion of durability and rebellious design. Built with ultra-lightweight, corrosion-resistant titanium, this dive watch is as tough as it is sleek. Featuring the groundbreaking “Sins Window,” it allows wearers to rebel against or embrace a new sin each day—adding a touch of mischief to your daily grind. Custom switchblade-inspired hands slice through time with precision, while Super-LumiNova coating ensures the hands and indices glows brilliantly in the depths or the dark. Water-resistant to withstand even your wildest adventures, the Seven Sins watch is the ultimate statement for those who live unapologetically.
